label: training-gym-r35-complete
context:
Training Gym R35 completed. All 4 exercises 10/10 (2 required bug fixes).

R35 RESULTS (all 10/10):
1. fenwick-001 (T6) - Fenwick Tree (BIT) for prefix sums with O(n) build. 6 tests.
2. rope-001 (T7) - Rope data structure for efficient string ops (split, concat, insert, delete). 7 tests. Bug: __getitem__ slice took wrong side of second split.
3. persistent-dsu-001 (T7) - Persistent Union-Find with snapshot/rollback. 5 tests.
4. lru-callback-001 (T6) - LRU Cache with eviction callbacks and stats via OrderedDict. 7 tests. Bug: test had get(2) which was actually a hit, not a miss.

KEY PATTERNS:
- Fenwick: LSB trick i&(-i), 1-indexed internally, range_sum = prefix(r) - prefix(l-1)
- Rope: recursive split returns (left_node, right_node), for slice take LEFT of second split
- Persistent DSU: NO path compression, push (child, old_parent, parent, old_size, old_count) before each union
- LRU: OrderedDict.move_to_end on get, popitem(last=False) for LRU eviction

DB: 214 exercises, 379 attempts, avg 9.86
decisions: Rope slice: split(start) then split(stop-start) on right part, take LEFT of second split
Persistent UF: skip path compression entirely, union by size still works
LRU stats: verify test assertions match actual behavior (get existing key = hit, not miss)
Fenwick O(n) build: initialize tree[1..n]=arr[0..n-1], then for each i, tree[i+(i&-i)] += tree[i]
next_steps: Design R36 exercises. Continue with advanced topics: Suffix Array, AVL Tree, LFU Cache, or Disjoint Set with path splitting.
